subject.title: [Bug]: WebChat can render assistant reply before user prompt and duplicate inbound messages

question: Should #95566 be owned by a revised version of PR #80670's eager WebChat user-turn persistence path, or should maintainers first require a fresh current-main reproduction before sponsoring more code changes?
rationale: The remaining evidence spans WebChat UI ordering, gateway ACK timing, and shared transcript recorder ownership, and the closest candidate PR is open with review blockers rather than a safe canonical fix.

options.title: Revise PR #80670 as the canonical fix
options.body: Port the useful eager-persistence idea onto the current shared recorder path, preserving SessionManager-backed transcript writes and proving active same-session, rollover, and duplicate-suppression behavior.

options.title: Require a fresh current-main repro first
options.body: Keep the issue open but do not sponsor more repair work until a current main run reproduces the assistant-before-user and duplicate inbound-context symptoms together.

options.title: Split the cluster
options.body: Track duplicate assistant-final/history rendering under #85771 and keep #95566 only for durable inbound user-turn duplication and ACK ordering.

recommendation.title: Revise PR #80670 as the canonical fix
recommendation.body: Port the useful eager-persistence idea onto the current shared recorder path, preserving SessionManager-backed transcript writes and proving active same-session, rollover, and duplicate-suppression behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The highest-risk unresolved choice is the shared transcript recorder and gateway persistence boundary shaped by Shakker's recent work.
